venture.name: Handoff Note
venture.oneSentenceThesis: A focused handoff record for freelance web developers finishing small client projects.
venture.targetUser: A solo freelance web developer completing a client website
venture.painfulJob: Gather scattered access notes, maintenance guidance, and acceptance steps into one trustworthy handoff
venture.desiredOutcome: Publish one clear read-only handoff that the client can review
venture.proposition: Close a client website with one structured handoff that becomes a clear read-only client record
venture.differentiation: A narrow project-closing record instead of an ongoing project-management workspace
venture.founderAdvantage: First-hand experience delivering and closing small client web projects

product.oneCoreFeature: A structured handoff checklist that becomes a read-only client link
primaryJourney: The freelancer signs in and creates one handoff.
The freelancer completes the required handoff sections and previews the client view.
The freelancer publishes the handoff and opens its read-only link.
product.designThesis: Treat the handoff like a well-made field manual with calm hierarchy, explicit completion states, and no dashboard clutter.

business.commercialCommitmentEvent: The freelancer starts a EUR 9 monthly subscription in Stripe test mode for launch verification.

distribution.firstUserHabitat: Freelance web developer communities where project handoff problems are discussed
distribution.initialMessage: Close a client website with one clear handoff instead of another folder of scattered notes.
distribution.firstValidationAction: Invite five solo web developers with an active project handoff to complete and critique the full journey.

decision.continueRule: Continue if invited freelancers publish a real handoff and say the client view replaces their current handoff document.
decision.changeRule: Change the required sections if freelancers start a handoff but cannot finish it without returning to an external document.
decision.stopRule: Stop if freelancers complete the journey but consistently prefer their existing handoff document and will not reuse the product.

facts: This is a synthetic documentation example.
The example is a web product for solo freelance web developers.
assumptions: A structured checklist and read-only link are sufficient for the first useful outcome.
EUR 9 per month is only a price hypothesis.
inferences: Publishing a stable read-only link requires persisted state and owner authorization.
unknowns: Which handoff sections clients actually consult after delivery
Whether a recurring subscription matches an episodic handoff job
